value.data: Hebbal metro station on the Blue Line is under construction and expected to be operational around June 2026. It is planned as an interchange for Blue, Orange, and Red lines.

Daily commute in Hebbal is often characterized by heavy traffic congestion, particularly around the Hebbal flyover, though recent infrastructure improvements like new traffic loops have reduced travel times in some stretches.

Major upcoming projects include the Hebbal metro station (Blue Line, Orange Line, Red Line interchange), a tunnel road and elevated road from Hebbal Junction to Mekhri Circle (Rs 2,250 crore), a 2.18-km short tunnel road at Hebbal (Rs 1,086 crore), and the Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project with a station at Hebbal.

Hebbal is a premium residential locality in North Bengaluru, offering excellent connectivity to Kempegowda International Airport and major IT hubs like Manyata Tech Park. It provides a blend of urban amenities with natural beauty, including Hebbal Lake and green spaces, making it a desirable area for families and professionals despite persistent traffic congestion and waterlogging issues.
A vibrant, dynamic neighborhood that blends urban living with a sense of community spirit, known for its picturesque lake and modern infrastructure, attracting working professionals and families.

Hebbal Circle below the flyover and parts of the Outer Ring Road are highly prone to waterlogging, with incidents reported even after mild showers, leading to severe traffic snarls. Tata Nagar near Hebbal also experienced knee-deep waterlogging due to an overflowing lake.
